data_source: Yahoo Finance adjusted daily prices; USD portfolio and ACWI benchmark converted to EUR using EURUSD=X; ^IRX is a USD risk-free proxy

methodology.equity_region_weights: 15% each across four provisional regional sleeves
methodology.hedge_split: 24% Treasury (60% of HEDGE) + 16% GLD-USD (40% of HEDGE)
methodology.risk_free_proxy: ^IRX 13-week Treasury bill annualized yield, divided by 12 for monthly excess-return calculations
methodology.fourth_region: Other / residual universe, not verified as the official fourth LI sub-strategy
methodology.reporting_currency: EUR; USD holdings and ACWI benchmark converted monthly using EURUSD=X (USD per EUR)
methodology.warning: Scenario test only. Historical 60/40 and internal 60/40 hedge split are documented for 2020, not verified as current. Exact regional buckets, HEDGE selection algorithms, execution timing and ranking formula remain unconfirmed. The residual bucket is not a verified region. No fees, taxes or slippage. Risk-free ^IRX remains a USD proxy and is not currency-matched to EUR returns.
